preference_hierarchy: Role authorization -> Key Customer Price Preference -> Left Customer Quick Selection Preference

rules.price_off: Brand/Series disappears from Left Customer preference and cannot be priced/quoted/selected
rules.price_on: Brand/Series becomes available in Left Customer preference
rules.selection_memory: Preserved while Price is OFF and restored when Price is enabled again
rules.CHC_G1: Can be Price-enabled but never appears in Quick Selection because it has no curve
